utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks are pitching in for the repair drive—sounds like it’s picking up nicely! I can keep you posted if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—just let me know if there’s anything I should bring by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do—if I hear they need anything specific, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure this repair drive is still happening, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s still on. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — I’ll wait for the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll keep telling folks the plan so nobody misses it. Let me know what time you want me to share.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. I’m still waiting on the exact time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep an ear out and spread the word once you have it. Just send me the time when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m happy to help if you need me to do something.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — could you check the drop-off spot by the community center and let me know if the bins are still set up?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll swing by the community center and check the bins, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s start with the front porch steps and the leaky kitchen faucet — those feel most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll handle the porch steps first, then the kitchen faucet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up a bit—people are dropping things off after work. If you want, I can swing by and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks—I’d love a quick check on what’s still needed. I can help sort things out if you spot anything urgent.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll stop by after my errands and let you know what’s still needed. If anything urgent comes up, I’ll text you right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. Just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that’s a huge help. Could you take point on sorting the donated tools and checking which repairs we can tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can do that. I’ll sort through the donated tools and make a first pass at the repairs we can start with.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need most, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Appreciate it, Cleo — I’ll send you the list and jump in when I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, send it over when you can, and I’ll start checking what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive details first. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about Saturday morning around 9? I can bring my tools and we can go over the repair drive details then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 9 works for me—I’ll make it around the school schedule. Just send me the repair drive details and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure you can help spread the word about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Definitely — I’ll tell both groups and make sure the repair drive gets around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 9 a.m. in the school parking lot—just bring the item that needs repair and any parts or chargers you already have.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 a.m. at the school lot works for me. I’ll bring the repair item and whatever parts or charger I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a little fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’m mostly worried about the pickup schedule and where everything gets sorted. If you can help keep track of that, it’d be a big relief.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can keep an eye on the pickup schedule and help sort things out. Just point me to where the updates are, and I’ll do my best to stay on top of it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word right away. Want me to tell folks to bring tools, snacks, or just their good vibes?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Tools would be great, and maybe a few snacks too. Good vibes are always welcome.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll tell everyone to bring tools, snacks, and plenty of good vibes. I’ll get the word out fast!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s handling the pickups. Do we have the route and a clear plan yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep it simple: we’re finalizing the route now, and I’ll make sure the pickup list is clear before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks. If you send me the route and pickup list once they’re set, I can help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon—if you’ve got a spare minute, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, sure—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together from the grapevine, honestly—do you know where they’re meeting or what they need first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s make sure we have the supplies and a clear list of homes to visit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I can help with the supplies and walk the list of homes with you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — that would be a big help. I’ll draft the home list and we can compare notes on supplies before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what needs repairing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll check on that and get back to you with the date, time, and repair details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update with the date, time, and repair details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Noah — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — could you handle collecting the donated tools and sorting them by type? I’ve been a bit all over the place, so that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll collect the donated tools and sort them by type.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring what I can manage, but I need to keep it low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s fine—what can you bring, and what should I count on you for?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a box of supplies and maybe help sort things for an hour. I just can’t stay long or make a fuss about it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane — it’s going steady. I’ve got a clear little plan, and I’m just keeping to the routine.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — glad it’s moving along. Want me to jump in wherever you need a hand?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can bring over my tool kit and lend a hand for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that’d be great. Can you double-check which tools you’re bringing so we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, a tape measure, pliers, and my cordless drill. If you think of anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going—do you still need tools or extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I could still use a couple of wrenches and maybe one extra pair of hands if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring the wrenches and help for an hour—what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where the repair drive is happening, if that helps. Just tell me the location and I’ll remember it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be a huge help, Opal — it’s at the community hall on Maple Street, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community hall on Maple Street. I’ll keep that location in mind.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the basics and I’ll try to help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — we still need screwdrivers, duct tape, a hammer, and a few extension cords. I’ll keep a running list if more comes up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can probably grab a screwdriver and some duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam! Could you help collect the donated tools and carry them over to the community shed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can do that. I’ll collect the donated tools and bring them over to the community shed.
